messages:
Eve Kim: Hey all — starting Monday and Id like to use my personal Dell XPS (Ubuntu 22.04) for a few days while my company laptop arrives. Quick questions: 1) I dual-boot and currently have Secure Boot off. Is that a hard blocker? 2) The phishing sim is Wed — if Im still pending enrollment will I lose access? 3) Any special rules for certs on dual-boot machines? Thanks!

Jordan (People Ops): Welcome Eve! :wave: Short answers: we prefer company devices but grant short BYOD exceptions. Secure Boot preferred but not strictly blocking if you can enable TPM or we escrow keys. PhishSim: missing it wont immediately cut access, but you must complete the module quickly.

IT-helpdesk: We can do BYOD for your XPS. Must install our management agent (remote-wipe + vault), enable disk encryption (LUKS2), and have screensaver lock + SSO 2FA. If secure boot is off well ask for a LUKS header backup. Please paste sanitized `uname -a` and `lsblk -f` before the enrollment session. We can run a guided 15-min walkthrough.

Marcus (Security): Policy notes: - BYOD requires signed MOU and agent. - If TPM present we prefer binding keys to TPM. If not, agent escrow to KMS is acceptable. - Failures on PhishSim trigger coaching and remedial training; repeated misses escalate.

Eve Kim: Got it. Follow-ups: a) I have TPM but not enabled in firmware; b) I use a local password manager and GPG keys; c) how do I sign the MOU?

IT-helpdesk: a) Enabling TPM usually safe, but backup LUKS header first (`sudo cryptsetup luksHeaderBackup --header-backup-file header.img /dev/sda3`). b) Password managers/GPG are fine — do not store company certs in plaintext. c) Jordan will send a DocuSign link.

Jordan (People Ops): DocuSign sent. Also tentatively scheduling a 15-min enroll slot tomorrow 11:30am PT. @onboarding-bot please set Eves security training due end of week and open phishsim window.

onboarding-bot: Assigned training: "Security Quickstart" due 2025-04-25. PhishSim window: 2025-04-22 -> 2025-04-28. Reminder: 2x.

Eve Kim: Pasted sanitized outputs: `uname -a`: Linux eve-xps 5.15.0-70-generic x86_64
`lsblk -f`:
NAME FSTYPE LABEL UUID
sda
sda1 vfat 1A2B-3C4D
sda2 ext4 3c4d5e6f-...
sda3 crypto_LUKS 0a1b2c3d-...

Eve Kim: Signed the MOU via DocuSign and confirmed the 11:30am PT slot. Appreciate the quick help! :thumbsup:
